decision.primary_path: direct vscode.lm Language Model API in the active window extension host
decision.discovery: vscode.lm.selectChatModels called only downstream of explicit user Start, Retry, or new-task action
decision.requests: LanguageModelChat.sendRequest called only in that explicitly initiated bounded episode

change_events.onDidChangeChatModels: invalidate catalog, cancel or degrade affected requests, and update sanitized UI only; never discover or request in background
change_events.languageModelAccessInformation.onDidChan: invalidate access state, cancel or degrade affected requests, and update sanitized UI only; never discover or request in background

decision.mcp_sampling: comparison only; never an inference, authentication, or fallback path

authentication.exclusive_authority: active VS Code/Copilot session in the exact window
forbidden: credential refresh, storage, copying, logging, or transport

model_selection.truth_source: models actually returned by fresh selectChatModels discovery in the current window
required: match returned model metadata and required capabilities
never infer availability from configured provider name
never silently substitute a family or model

isolation.transport: connected stdio or anonymous inherited pipes; alternatively a random owner-only per-task OS endpoint unlinked on close

agent_loop.workspace_rule: canonical paths must remain inside the isolated allowed workspace and allowed_writes

runtime.streaming: ordered correlated chunks with finite flow credit and bounded queues
runtime.retry: bounded transient-only retry inside the explicit episode, within deadline and only before non-idempotent tool effects
runtime.shutdown: stop starts, cancel owned requests, bounded terminal delivery, close owned channels, dispose listeners, clear window-local memory

circuit_breaker.while_open: remains open until explicit user Retry or new-task action starts one fresh bounded recovery episode
circuit_breaker.recovery: fresh discovery and access verification in that explicit episode; only a successful model response closes the circuit; failure leaves it open

failure_safety.dashboard: responsive with exact sanitized degraded capability
never: read or fall back to credential files
fall back to BYOK, OAuth, MCP Sampling, legacy adapter, or another model

migration: Introduce vscode_lm behind the adapter boundary with protocol negotiation and feature flag.
Keep claude_cli, codex_cli, deepseek_copilot_cli, and glm_copilot_cli names parseable only for deprecation and alias mapping; never execute them.
Canary vscode_lm, then make it default; unavailable aliases degrade without fallback.
Remove provider-specific automatic adapters after the compatibility window; historical records remain readable and retry creates a new vscode_lm episode.

change handlers call neither selectChatModels nor sendRequest
